title: 복습 A: 모음 소리 확인하기
objective: Read and say the basic vowels correctly, and tell apart ㅓ/ㅗ, ㅡ/ㅜ, and the plain vowels from the y-vowels.
summary: A review sheet for the Korean vowels beginners mix up most.

task.title: Read, choose, and write
task.line: Say each word out loud first, then follow the instruction for each item.

words.exampleMeaning: I drink milk in the morning.

letters.sound: ㅓ [ʌ]: mouth open, lips relaxed. ㅗ [o]: lips small and round.
letters.as: ㅓ like 'u' in 'cup'; ㅗ like 'o' in 'more'

letters.sound: ㅡ [ɯ]: lips flat, like a small smile. ㅜ [u]: lips round, pushed forward.
letters.as: ㅜ like 'oo' in 'food'; ㅡ has no close English sound

letters.sound: One extra short stroke adds a 'y': [ja] [jʌ] [jo] [ju].
letters.as: ㅑ like 'ya' in 'yard'; ㅕ like 'yu' in 'yum'; ㅛ like 'yo' in 'yoga'; ㅠ like 'you'

exercises: Which word has the vowel ㅓ (open mouth)? ① 고기 / 거기 ② 어디 / 도시
Which word has the vowel ㅡ (flat lips)? ① 구두 / 그리고 ② 스키 / 우리
Choose the right vowel to complete the word: ① ㄱ_사 teacher (ㅗ or ㅛ) ② ㅎ_지 tissue (ㅜ or ㅠ) ③ ㅇ_자 woman (ㅓ or ㅕ)
Read both aloud. Do they sound the same? Write Yes or No: ① 여 – 요 ② 어 – 오 ③ 그 – 구
Write the word in Hangeul: ① meori (head) ② haru (one day) ③ yuri (glass)
answers: ① ㅛ (교사) ② ㅠ (휴지) ③ ㅕ (여자)
① No ② No ③ No
① 머리 ② 하루 ③ 유리
